paragraphs.text: Foot passengers should arrive 20 minutes before departure, vehicles 45 minutes. Boarding closes 10 minutes before the sailing time and late arrivals are not carried, even with a valid ticket.
Tickets are valid on any sailing on the date shown. Dogs travel free but must stay on the outside deck. In rough weather the 7.15 crossing may be combined with the 9.30; passengers are told by text.

items.quote: Foot passengers should arrive 20 minutes before departure, vehicles 45 minutes
items.prompt: Drivers should arrive earlier than foot passengers.

explanation.en: 45 minutes against 20 — drivers arrive earlier → TRUE.
explanation.kk: 45 минут пен 20 — ертерек келу қажет → TRUE.
explanation.ru: 45 минут против 20 — приезжать надо раньше → TRUE.

items.quote: Boarding closes 10 minutes before the sailing time and late arrivals are not carried, even with a valid ticket
items.prompt: A passenger with a ticket who arrives five minutes before departure will be carried.

explanation.en: Boarding closes 10 minutes before and a ticket does not help → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Отырғызу 10 минут бұрын жабылады, билет көмектеспейді → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Посадка закрывается за 10 минут, билет не помогает → FALSE.

items.quote: Tickets are valid on any sailing on the date shown
items.prompt: A ticket can be used on a later sailing the same day.

explanation.en: A ticket is valid on any sailing that day → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Билет сол күнгі кез келген рейске жарамды → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Билет действует на любой рейс этого дня → TRUE.

items.quote: Dogs travel free but must stay on the outside deck
items.prompt: Bicycles are carried free of charge.

explanation.en: Dogs are mentioned, bicycles are not mentioned at all → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Ит туралы айтылған, ал велосипед туралы мәтінде ештеңе жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Про собак сказано, а про велосипеды в тексте нет ни слова → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
